beginner.title: Get started with Excalidraw
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Excalidraw, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: First diagram
beginner.outcome: You can: draw a clear diagram

beginner.title: Use templates
beginner.outcome: You can: start from proven templates
beginner.practice: Recreate a process with a swimlane template

intermediate.title: Standards and notation
intermediate.outcome: You can: draw diagrams others understand
intermediate.practice: Redraw a process in BPMN style

intermediate.title: Collaborate
intermediate.outcome: You can: build diagrams with others
intermediate.practice: Co-create a diagram in a meeting

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Excalidraw
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Excalidraw distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Excalidraw
expert.outcome: You can: use Excalidraw's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Diagrams at scale
expert.outcome: You can: keep diagrams accurate over time
expert.practice: Link a diagram to data or code

expert.title: Integrate Excalidraw into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Excalidraw with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Excalidraw to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Excalidraw well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Excalidraw" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
